concerns.text: FR-015 explicitly mandates '3 independent human raters' to score trajectories for the Human Evaluation Proxy. Task T035-SIM implements a 'deterministic simulation' using a fixed seed and normal distribution instead of actual human raters. This is a missing task for the human rating requirement; the simulation does not cover the FR-015 requirement of human scoring.

FR-015 requires generating a 'Human Evaluation Proxy' by having humans score a subset. Task T035.1 only generates a 'human-annotated subset' file from existing data but lacks a task to actually perform the human scoring (or a task to integrate external human data). The 'Human' part of the proxy is missing a corresponding task.

SC-006 requires the AntiSD score to be '≥ 0.2 points higher' than standard self-distillation when validated via the Human Evaluation Proxy. Since T035-SIM uses a random simulation rather than human consensus, there is no task to generate the valid human-consensus metric required to satisfy SC-006.

Task T035-SIM is tagged with [US3] and references FR-015, FR-010, SC-001, SC-006. However, the task description admits it is a 'deterministic simulation' and 'fallback' for when manual recruitment is not feasible. This tag implies coverage of FR-015 (Human Raters) which the task explicitly does not perform, creating a stale/misleading tag for the human requirement.
